data.name: Workflow: Resume Due Runs
data.description: Resumes base.workflow.run rows waiting on a retry whose next attempt is due (SRS-F-015).

data.name: Workflow: Reap Stale Running Runs
data.description: Reclaims base.workflow.run rows stranded at status=running by a dead worker or hung step handler.

data.name: Workflow: Sweep Outbound Deliveries
data.description: Sends queued notify deliveries the worker never sent, reclaims deliveries stuck at sending and retries due retryable_failed deliveries with exponential backoff (plan T53).
